about: The domain seams of Kolwen (scripts/lib/domain-seams.mjs reads this file; surface-check rule 20 holds it). A GROUP is a set of pages that can move to its own host later. Today the one group is the company site, which serves every page at kolwen.com, and nothing here is a domain bought or a page moved. A group moves by a web/_redirects change (301 from each of its paths to the new host) and by taking its pages to its own zone, never by rewriting a page. A ZONE is one Worker with one publish root and one headers file, so its Content-Security-Policy is its own rule set: Cloudflare joins the values of two matching rules, so two zones never share a headers file. A group is added to this file by its own unit, when it has something real to serve.

company.role: the company site: home, pricing, legal pages, changelog, and the status page, which is not announced
